_comment: Canonical registry of every company automation, one JSON object per line (Tim 2026-10-20: registered in one place, measured, auditable). Line 1 is this header; each later line is one automation, with runsAs naming the identity in canon/agent-identities.json it runs as. scripts/lib/automation-registry.mjs validates it; CI fails when a GitHub cron, Vercel cron or lanes clock exists without a live entry. Personal automations (Zoe) are out of scope and stay private.

purpose: Probe Jovie and Summer production availability, spend pauses and production freshness; page founder and admit provider recovery.
metric: production availability + production freshness incidents (time to detect)

heartbeat.proof: a completed Production Continuity Guard run (success = healthy verdict, failure = unhealthy verdict filed); a cancelled, skipped or absent run is silence

trigger.schedule: event: Staging Controller -> Production Controller on main

purpose: Independent dead-man for the release pipeline: production must carry main within the max silence, whatever the continuity guard reports.
metric: production lag: age of the oldest main commit production lacks (p50/p95 in shipping SLO)
killSwitch: remove this entry (observation only; nothing to stop)

heartbeat.proof: jov.ie build-info commitSha equals main, or the oldest unshipped commit reached main within max silence (landing time is its earliest push-event run at or after the committer date; a missing receipt uses the committer date); an unreadable build-info or GitHub read is silence

trigger.schedule: event: merge-group checks -> merge to main

purpose: Dead-man for the merge queue: a non-empty main queue must merge within the max silence. Catches stalls that emit no workflow_run wake or failure-hold receipt (2026-10-20 21:13-21:52Z, JOV-8706).
metric: minutes since last merge while the queue is non-empty (queue stall duration)

receipt.location: GraphQL repository.mergeQueue(branch: main) + latest merged PR mergedAt

killSwitch: remove this entry (observation only; nothing to stop)

heartbeat.proof: main merge queue empty, or the later of the last merged PR (mergedAt) and the oldest entry's enqueuedAt is younger than max silence; an unreadable queue is silence

note: Spec from ci-plan 2026-10-21. Root fix #22433, guard #22394. 45 min = ~2x merge-group p95 (23.9 min over 48h); retune to 1.5x queue-head-dwell p95 once stage timings measure it.
